description: Verifies deterministic record and replay: a geodesic bundle is evolved for ten thousand ticks while randomly generated impulse and mass events are recorded in the journal, then the journal is rewound and the same evolution is replayed from the recorded events alone, and the SHA-256 digests of the two final bundle states must be identical.

checks.label: the recording session stores events in the journal
the recorded evolution changes the bundle state
the replay consumes every recorded event
the record and replay digests are identical
